name: Checkbox
description: A material design checkbox. Allows the user to select one or more options. Typically used in forms or settings.

properties.name: value
properties.possible_values: true, false, or null (if tristate is true)

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user taps the checkbox to change its state.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: The fill color of the checkbox when it is checked.

properties.name: checkColor
properties.description: The color of the check icon inside the checkbox.

properties.name: tristate
properties.description: Whether the checkbox can have three states: true, false, or null.

properties.name: materialTapTargetSize
properties.description: Configures the minimum size of the tap target.

properties.name: focusColor
properties.description: The color of the checkbox when it has keyboard focus.

properties.name: hoverColor
properties.description: The color of the checkbox when a pointer is hovering over it.
